xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4447: Session Vault: dashboard continued-on states ("Continued on <machine>", "Local turns saved as a fork")

plan.title: Session Vault: dashboard continued-on states ("Continued on <machine>", "Local turns saved as a fork")
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: When machine B continues a conversation machine A started (pan vault resume or Continue here), A's dashboard shows nothing: the row and composer look unchanged. If the operator keeps typing on A, settle() saves those turns as a settlement fork (PAN-2609 P-6) silently. The operator cannot see that the conversation moved or that local turns were split off.
narratives.Proposal: List-cache rows gain parentVaultId and forkKind ('settlement' for P-6 forks, detected by segments[0].prefix === null; 'version' for @<n> forks). A pure engine function roundTripStates(index) in src/lib/vault/round-trip.ts maps each owned native path to continued-elsewhere or forked-locally. src/lib/overdeck/conversation-vault-continuity.ts matches conversation rows to owned paths (Claude by <claudeSessionId>.jsonl basename, Codex by ${OVERDECK_HOME}/agents/<tmuxSession>/ prefix, greatest path wins) and getConversationListWithVaultCopies attaches vaultContinuity to every local row with one local-index read per call. The frontend shows a 'continued on <label>' chip on the row and a VaultContinuityNotice above the still-enabled composer with a 'View its copy' link to vault-<vaultId>, plus the fork line for forked-locally. Docs describe both states.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A 'Save local turns as a fork' button; the engine already saves them.
- Making the composer read-only for a continued-elsewhere conversation.
- vaultContinuity on GET /api/conversations/<id> (StandaloneRoutes.tsx), the Agents Directory (getEnrichedConversationList) or lanes.
- A CLI display of these states in pan vault list or show.
- States for version forks (@<n>), harnesses other than claude-code and codex, or agent (non-conversation) transcripts.
- A new WebSocket or push event for state changes; the 10 s conversation-list poll carries it.
- Any edit to ConversationPanel.tsx, src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts or the PAN-4437 continue flow.
- Writing, moving or deleting any native transcript.

autoDecisions.summary: Distinguish settlement forks from version forks with a forkKind field on ListCacheRow, derived from segments[0]?.prefix === null.
autoDecisions.rationale: Version forks (forkRecordAtVersion) also set record.parent, so parentVaultId alone would mislabel a pan vault resume <id>@<n> fork as 'local turns saved as a fork'. Only settle() writes a first segment with a null prefix; claimAndMaterialize always writes a non-null prefix. Keeping parentVaultId = record.parent?.vaultId matches the issue text.

autoDecisions.summary: Name the engine function roundTripStates / type RoundTripState in src/lib/vault/round-trip.ts, keep the wire field vaultContinuity.
autoDecisions.rationale: continuity.ts already exports checkContinuity/ContinuityResult for line-hash tails; reusing the word in the engine would confuse executors. The issue fixes the file name round-trip.ts and the wire field vaultContinuity.

autoDecisions.summary: When several owned paths match one conversation, the lexicographically greatest path wins.
autoDecisions.rationale: A Codex agent dir can hold several rollout files whose names embed their start time, so the greatest is the newest; the rule is deterministic and needs no file I/O.

autoDecisions.summary: Attach vaultContinuity to local rows on every page, not only the first, and give browse rows null.
autoDecisions.rationale: Continuity is a per-row fact; the existing first-page-only early return exists for browse copies, not for per-row fields. One local-index read per call is cheap.

autoDecisions.summary: An unreadable or corrupt local index yields null for every row with a warn-once log, never a list error.
autoDecisions.rationale: The conversation list is core UI; a broken vault index must not take it down.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the composer enabled in both states; ship 'Save local turns as a fork' as displayed state, not a button.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states the engine already saves local turns as a fork (P-6); typing on the first machine is what produces the fork.

autoDecisions.summary: 'View its copy' opens vault-<vaultId> for continued-elsewhere and vault-<parentVaultId> for forked-locally through ComposerFooter's existing openConversationRoute.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4436 creates a browse row for every non-tombstone record owned elsewhere, so the row the other machine owns exists on this machine after the same sync; reusing the existing client-side route helper adds no new navigation path.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the frontend VaultContinuity type in ConversationList.tsx and the notice in a new VaultContinuityNotice.tsx file.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the PAN-4436 pattern (origin, vaultOwnerLabel live on the frontend Conversation type) and keeps ComposerFooter.tsx (942/1000 lines) within the file-size ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: No new push event; rely on the conversation list's 10 s refetch.
autoDecisions.rationale: CommandDeck/index.tsx already polls ['conversations'] every 10 s, and PAN-4436's browse refresh emits conversation.created when the browse row appears.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1. Add optional parentVaultId?: string and forkKind?: 'settlement' | 'version' to ListCacheRow in src/lib/vault/local-index.ts. In syncOnce step 4 (src/lib/vault/sync.ts, the non-tombstone rows.push), spread { parentVaultId: value.parent.vaultId, forkKind: value.segments[0]?.prefix === null ? 'settlement' : 'version' } only when value.parent is non-null, so rows without a parent and tombstone rows carry neither key. Add two cases to tests/unit/lib/vault/sync.test.ts: a P-6 fork row (A settles, B takes ownership, A appends and syncs) and a forkRecordAtVersion row.

items.title: Given B owns A's record, when A appends a line and runs syncOnce, then the fork's list-cache row stores parentVaultId equal to the original vaultId and forkKind 'settlement'
When syncOnce pulls a record created by forkRecordAtVersion, its list-cache row stores forkKind 'version'
When syncOnce pulls a record whose parent is null, its list-cache row contains neither a parentVaultId nor a forkKind key, and existing sync/browse tests pass unedited
roundTripStates returns continued-elsewhere and forked-locally per owned path

expected_outputs: round-trip.test.ts passes every rule case; import-graph.test.ts passes unchanged

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/vault/round-trip.ts exporting type RoundTripState and the pure function roundTripStates(index: Pick<LocalIndex, 'owned' | 'listCache'>): Map<string, RoundTripState>, importing only types from ./local-index.js. Apply FR-2's rules in order: no row or tombstone row means no entry; row owned elsewhere means continued-elsewhere with the row's ownerLabel; row owned here with forkKind 'settlement', a parentVaultId, and a non-tombstone parent row owned elsewhere means forked-locally with forkVaultId, parentVaultId and parentOwnerLabel. Write tests/unit/lib/vault/round-trip.test.ts with literal LocalIndex fixtures, one case per rule.

items.title: Given an owned entry whose list-cache row has ownerIsHere false, roundTripStates returns { kind: 'continued-elsewhere', vaultId, ownerLabel } for that path
Given an owned settlement-fork row whose parent row is owned elsewhere, roundTripStates returns { kind: 'forked-locally', forkVaultId, parentVaultId, parentOwnerLabel }
roundTripStates returns no entry for owned-here rows, tombstone rows, missing rows, version forks, and settlement forks whose parent is owned here, tombstoned or missing
When import-graph.test.ts runs, it passes with round-trip.ts reachable from the vault modules

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4. Create src/lib/overdeck/conversation-vault-continuity.ts exporting buildVaultContinuityLookup(index, overdeckHome), async loadVaultContinuityLookup(overdeckHome = getOverdeckHome()) and vaultContinuityFor(conv, lookup). Build a Map<basename, path[]> for claude-code entries and a Map<tmuxSession, path[]> for codex entries under <overdeckHome>/agents/ in one pass, sorted ascending. vaultContinuityFor returns null for origin 'vault' rows and other harnesses, matches Claude rows (harness claude-code/null/undefined) by <claudeSessionId>.jsonl and Codex rows by tmuxSession, takes the last (greatest) candidate and returns its state or null. loadVaultContinuityLookup catches readLocalIndex errors, warns once per message with a module-level Set, and falls back to an empty index.
